# Review 2026-09-02, open findings

Consolidated from simplify, codex review and codex roast over `2115eae..HEAD`.
The three must-fix items (fit cost, wrapWords chop, skip on rebuild) are fixed and committed.
Everything below is yours to call.
Comment on a line to say yes, no, or how.

## Should fix

- Cursor can land on a hidden line when everything below it is hidden.
  - `pin` at `src/core/caret.ts:72` steps down only, never falls back up.
  - Reachable in flow mode on a document ending in a wrapped paragraph.
  - Fix: try the other direction when the first finds nothing.

- Piped output now draws box-drawing table rules.
  - `styleTable` applies `rule()` even without color, `src/core/renderer.ts:334`.
  - `bun src/bin.ts file.md | cat` shows `├───┼───┤` where the source had `|---|---|`.
  - Landed in `0240da7` (table rules), so it is deliberate for the TUI.
  - Question: should non-TTY output keep the source separators so agents can round-trip?

- Dead code left after the caret rewrite.
  - `scroll` and `pan` in `src/core/viewport.ts` have no callers outside their tests.
  - `gap` in `src/core/caret.ts` is exported but only `fit` uses it.
  - Fix: delete the two functions and their tests, un-export `gap`.

- Notes are laid out twice per draw.
  - `rows()` and `owners()` in `src/core/inline.ts` each call `build()`.
  - `slice()` at `src/ui/tui.ts:653` re-lays every note although `click()` already holds `opts`.
  - Only costs with many notes; fix is to pass the built layout through.

## Nice to have

- Modal width is frozen at construction.
  - `inner` in `src/ui/modal.ts` never changes; `place()` only recenters.
  - Pre-existing, the box itself never re-widened either.

- Double-click state is never cleared.
  - `tap` in `src/ui/tui.ts` survives overlays, reload and resize.
  - Needs a click, a transition, and a second click on the same row inside 500 ms.
  - Fix: reset `tap` in `open()` and `reloadDoc()`.

- Duplication the diff added.
  - `renderer.ts:479` repeats `bare()` from `renderer.ts:375`.
  - `end()` in `caret.ts` repeats the open-coded pin at `tui.ts:372`.
  - Three pasted `if (skip > 0)` guards in `render()`, `renderer.ts:432,446,460`.
  - `chrome.ts:135` uses a second absolute `TextRenderable` where `help.ts:43` uses `StyledText`.
  - `inline.ts:89-101` writes the color and plain layout twice.

- `skip` is half a Caret bolted onto a line-granular viewport.
  - Written only by `draw()`, read only by `render()` and `fit`.
  - Options: make `offset` a Caret, or keep `skip` in `TuiShell` instead of `Viewport`.

- The cursor slab color lives in the SGR parser.
  - `src/core/ansi.ts` special-cases code 100 to `#2b2d2b`.
  - Only the renderer's own output reaches the parser, so this is theoretical.
